Subject: Redwood marketplace demo — staged handoff proposal

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. Aurora SI is excited to move to a two-stage demo for the Redwood marketplace listing: an executive overview for our EA/POs followed by a deep technical run with our system integrator engineers.

Proposed plan:
- Stage 1 (45m): Business-focused overview + success metrics — target attendees: Aurora sales leadership, two product owners, Redwood AE (Priya).
- Stage 2 (90m): Technical walkthrough + Q&A + runbook review — target attendees: Aurora SI architects, Redwood eng lead, and SI delivery TLs.

We prefer a staggered schedule so our APAC teams can join the technical run outside their peak hours. Could we aim for the week of Oct 12? I attached a quick draft runbook (aurora-runbook-v0.3.pdf) and a tentative itinerary.

Two asks for coordination:
1) Can Redwood provide an ops owner for the technical run to own recording + redwood-demo-itinerary.xlsx updates?
2) Who should we loop in on Redwood's side for latency/capacity Qs (GPU sizing/quantization)?

Appreciate a short sync to lock times + owner names.

Best,
Elliot
Partnerships | Aurora SI
